title: Ability of Patients With Low Vision to Properly Instill Eye Drops
brief_summary: The investigators are interested in seeing how people with low vision (decreased visual acuity or restricted visual fields) instill eye drops into their own eyes. The investigators hypothesis is that this population will have more difficulty with self-instillation of drops than a better-seeing population. The investigators aim to explore whatever factors may be involved in preventing this population from getting prescribed eyedrops into their eyes, whether it is more related to visual field or visual acuity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ETDRS visual acuity 20/60 or worse

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwilling to participate
* Light perception vision
* No light perception vision
study_population: Patients reporting for appointments at outpatients referral practices shared by 2 glaucoma and 3 retina specialists
